import zlib,struct
d=open('spec.png','rb').read()
p=8;chunks=[];idat=b''
while p<len(d):
    l,t=struct.unpack('>I4s',d[p:p+8]);c=d[p+8:p+8+l];p+=12+l
    if t==b'IHDR':print(struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',c))
    if t==b'IDAT':idat+=c
    if t not in(b'IDAT',):print(t,l)
open('/tmp/idat','wb').write(idat)
